name: ISM University of Management and Economics
summary: Private business university in Vilnius; six English-taught bachelor's in business, economics and finance; an IB diploma counts as proof of English.

ib.text: An IB or European Baccalaureate diploma proves your English. Needs maths; main-round score minimum 5.5 from IB grades converted under Lithuanian order V-712; finishing the IB adds 0.3 points; interview for all.

lastYear.text: early by 30 April; main (EU) by 24 July

programmes.name: Business Management and Marketing
programmes.about: Management foundations, marketing, human resources, finance and processes, with analytical skills applied to real company problems.

needs.note: Counts 30% in early admission; IB also proves English

programmes.selectionNote: Early round: school grades (maths 40%, a second subject 30%, English 30%) and motivation count half each. Main round: a competitive score of at least 5.5 and an interview.

programmes.name: Economics and Data Analytics
programmes.about: Economics, data analytics and applied AI: understanding economic processes from consumer behaviour to global trends, with Python programming, econometrics and machine learning.

programmes.selectionNote: Early round: school grades (maths 40%, a second subject 30%, English 30%) and motivation count half each. Main round: a competitive score of at least 5.5 and an interview.

programmes.about: Economics, political science and business studied together, for work as an analyst, manager or researcher, with debate clubs and events alongside lectures.

programmes.about: Learning by experimenting with technology and startups; a three-year degree for developing a startup or moving up in innovative companies.

notes: Fees are the same for EU and non-EU students: €3,570 a semester for the 3.5-year degrees and €4,165 for the 3-year one, €24,990 in all; a €500 reservation fee counts towards the first semester.
Two rounds for EU applicants: early admission (application opens 1 November) gives a conditional place on school grades and motivation; the main round runs to July. Both need a €100 application fee.
A maths state exam is required, or the ISM maths test if you have not taken one; top early applicants may sit an online maths, English and logic test for a scholarship.
